title: Najib Rohilla Seeks Mediation Through Ragho Malhar

blocks.text: Confronted by a swelling coalition, Najib Rohilla abandons hopes of easy victory. A new strategy must he devise, and the page shows him searching among surrender, bribery, pressure, and negotiation for any path that might spare him from complete defeat.

That search leads him toward mediation. Ragho Malhar is brought into the narrative as the influential Maratha intermediary through whom Rohilla hopes to send his representatives and open a back channel that can defuse Jawahar Mal's anger without forcing a public collapse.

Money and persuasion become his chosen tools. He promises secretly a lot of ransom and urges the mediator to call to his camp for negotiation, trying to turn a battlefield crisis into a settlement before the combined Sikh and Jat pressure becomes irreversible.
